Fresh one-day Developer scratch org. Synthetic Account and Contact records were inserted by each anonymous Apex probe. At each API version (62.0 and 67.0) the Flow metadata was deployed and each Flow ran at its matching API version. Each probe prints the value and the Apex runtime type (Integer, Decimal or Id) of the field written by the Transform Map element. The C flows (variable scale 0 and 2 mapped to NumberOfEmployees and AnnualRevenue, plus Id/AccountId/OwnerId controls) are adjacent; the T Reference flows are the ones in flow_type_matrix and were redeployed unchanged. Record ids are replaced by SAME_AS_INPUT. The scratch org was deleted after capture.
